book.name: Paihowa
book.title: PAIHOWA Yesu ꞌana tohepwailao ꞌidi paihowa

content: Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina tauyama
Ma muliyetega paihowa sanina Penitikosi ꞌana sabwelo ꞌoina Yesu ꞌana tohemisao mabwaiyadi siꞌetoꞌautama,
ma hadai simiyamiya, ma galewega ꞌaigeda dagugu gide wediliya madouna sihesagoheya, ta ꞌidi hada ꞌalona gesowana ma toꞌaha wete sihesagohe,
ta ginaula ꞌaigeda siꞌiteya ꞌana ꞌita gide ꞌaiwe ninininimina, ma ꞌalataedi sitowa ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda debadiya.
Coinega mabwaiyadi Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌilohemahediya, ta sihegaina ma hali ꞌenana ma hali ꞌenana ꞌoidiyega sigwaegwae, beno Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina waiwaiyega.
Sauga nage ꞌoina totapwalolo meYudiya hali tupwega ma hali tupwega sitauya pwaima, ma Yelusalema ꞌoina simiyamiya,
ma daguguina sihesagoheya ta siꞌetoꞌautama, ma mabwaiyadi taudi ꞌenadiyega ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda gwae sihesagoheya ꞌoinega nuwadi ꞌihepwanopwanowa madouna,
ta sigwae, “Togidega, taudi togwaeyedi mabwaiyadi meGalili ꞌawa?
Ma togidega ta ꞌoinega mabwaiyada tauda ꞌenadega sigwaegwae,
ꞌenanaedi beno Palitiya, ma Midiya, ma Elama, ma Mesopotemiya ꞌana tomiya, ma Yudiya ma Kapadosiya, ma Ponito, ma Esiya, ma

Piligiya, ma Pamipiliya, ma Itipita, ta Libiya tupwainaowedi Sailini ꞌalona simiyamiya, ta taudi Lomega sitauyama, tupwadi meYudiya, ma tupwadi geya meYudiya ma hesi ꞌida tapwalolo ꞌoina sitagwalediya mahetediyao,
ma wete meKiliti, ma meAlebiya, ta mabwaiyada tauda ꞌenada hagana ma hagana ꞌoidiyega sigwaegwae Yehoba ꞌina paihowa waiwaidi weyahina.”
Coinega mabwaiyadi maꞌidi henuwanainaida siboidimo sigwaegwae, “Toꞌaha lamuna ta ꞌidi paihowa bewa gidemusa?”
Ma hesi ꞌiyadiyao tupwadi sigwae, “Nuwana weꞌaha waiwai ꞌoinega sihebuwa.”
Pita ꞌina hepwaila
Ma Pita ꞌiyanao site lebeni mahetenao sitoholo, ma Pita ꞌihegaina ma ꞌoidiya ꞌiloguguya, ꞌigwaeya, “Comi meYudiya ma Yelusalema ꞌana tomiyao mabwaiyami ꞌigu gwae wahesagohe, ma wanuwa sabwalena,
ꞌabehega ꞌima paihowa bewa geya weꞌaha waiwai ꞌoinega, weyahina ꞌabwa gonagona, geya numa yauyaule ꞌana tuta.
Ma hesi mwalo palopita Yoeli ꞌihepwaila nugeteya, ꞌigwae,
ꞌYehoba ꞌina hepwaila bewa gidemusa ꞌigwae:

content.text: Cabwa sauga ꞌana ꞌebelosaloha ꞌoina, Yaluyaluwagu yalosiwa tomota mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiya, ma natumiyao loheyadi nuwana natumiyao wahinedi siloguguya, ta ꞌimi hewahewaliyao siꞌeno mataꞌitaꞌita, ta ꞌimi babadao sinihi.
Moisa, tuta nage ꞌoina Yaluyaluwagu yalosiwa ꞌigu topaihowa, loheloheya ma wahiwahine ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌigu nuwatuhu sihepwaila nugete.
Ma ꞌebeꞌita henainaida yapaihowadi galewa, ta wete baleꞌuwa, gidemusa bweyaha ma ꞌaiwe ganinisa ma ꞌasu,
ta sinala ꞌiguguyou, ta waiꞌena ꞌana ꞌita ꞌihebweyaha, ma muliyetega Bada ꞌina sabwelo ꞌebe matauta ꞌilatu.
Ta ꞌeguma taiyawedi Bada saninega sibwaubwau nata ꞌiꞌabihetedi.’”

content: Pita wete ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “MeIsileli ꞌomi gwae bewa wahesagohe, Yesu tauna gwama Nasaleta matamiya Yehoba ꞌiheꞌitaeya ꞌabehega tauna ꞌina topaihowaina, weyahina Yesu ꞌina paihowa waiwaidi ma ꞌebe henainaida Yehoba ꞌina waiwaiyega ꞌipaihowediya, ma wasanasanapudi weyahina gamwagamwanimiya ꞌipaihowediya.
Yehoba mwalo hene Yesuina weyahina ꞌiloina, ma toꞌaha baleꞌuwa Yesu nata ꞌiloba Yehoba ꞌisanapu nugeteya, beno ꞌomi watebaeya, ta ꞌimi loina ꞌoinega tomota galadi kelose ꞌoina siloheꞌamasiya.
Ma Yehoba ꞌamasa ꞌina tupwa mwauna ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌabiheteya ta ꞌiꞌabihetoholo hileya, weyahina geya sowasowahina ma ꞌamasa ꞌina tupwa ꞌimiyamiya hataya.
Bewa weyahina mwalo Debida Yesu ꞌina gwae ꞌihepwaila nugeteya ꞌigwae,

content.text: ꞌBada yaꞌiteya mataguwega ꞌimiya hataya, ma ꞌigu ꞌebeulega ꞌimiyamiya, ta ꞌiꞌabihe waiwaiyegauwa ma sahena yaweꞌaweꞌa.
Coinega yayaliyaya madouna ma yahehepwatuwe, ma yahemisaeya ꞌane gesowana ꞌwapigu ꞌigalagala.
Taugu ꞌino loheya hesihesinuwaigu, eema sahena yaluyaluwagu ꞌulagulagu hataya toꞌamasao ꞌidi gogowa, ma gesowana wete ꞌwapigu ꞌimwahulu.
Ta hesi yawasi bwebweꞌana ꞌina ꞌeda ꞌuheꞌitaeya ꞌoiguwa, ꞌoinega matauwa ꞌuꞌabihe yaliyaya hataegau.’”

content: Ma Pita wete ꞌigwaeya, “Tasigwao, gwae bewa geya tubuda Debida weyahina, weyahina Debidaina tasanapuya ꞌabehega mwalohene ꞌiꞌamasa ta sigaliheya, ma bewa tuwa ꞌana galihina ꞌebwa ꞌimiyamiya.
Ma Debidaina palopita ꞌaigeda, ma Yehoba ꞌina gwae hemisa waiwaina ꞌoina ꞌinuwatuhu yahiya ꞌabehega ꞌabwa Debida tubuna ꞌaigeda Debidaina ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌiꞌewa Yehoba ꞌoinega.
Coinega Toꞌabihetenaina ꞌina toholohila ꞌisanapu nugeteya, ta ꞌihegwaeya ꞌabehega sahena toꞌamasao yaluyaluwadi ꞌidi gogo ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya hataya, ma wete ꞌwapina gesowana ꞌimwahumwahulu.
Bewa Yesu ꞌina ꞌamasega Yehoba ꞌiꞌabihetoholo hila pwaiya, ma tauna mabwaiyama ꞌaꞌiteya.

Coinega Yehoba ꞌiꞌabihaneheya ta tauna ꞌina ꞌebeulega ꞌimiyamiya, ma tauna Yaluyaluwa Tabunaina Yehoba mwalo ꞌigwae hemisaeya, ma bewa tuwa ꞌiꞌebwaya pwaimaiya, ꞌoinega paihowa bewa waꞌitaꞌitadi ma wahehesagohedi, tauna ꞌoinega sitauyama.
Weyahina Debida geya tauna ꞌina hane galewa weyahina ꞌigwae, ma Yesu hesi weyahina ꞌigwaeya, ꞌigwae,

content.text: ꞌYehoba ꞌigwae pwaiya ꞌigu Bada ꞌoina, “Cigu ꞌebeulega ꞌumiyatoi,
ma ꞌana siga tutaina ꞌa sahiyao yalagu suluhedi ꞌaheu ꞌadi ꞌebelagu ꞌoina.” ꞌ

content: “Bewa weyahina meIsileli mabwaiyami wasanapu bwaibwaini ꞌabehega Yehoba Yesu ꞌiꞌahwa bada pwaiyeya ma tauna Toꞌabihetena, tauna Yesuina waꞌabihekelose pwaiya.”
Loheloheyaedi Pita ꞌina gwae bewa sihesagoheya ta weyahina sinuwagala moisa, ma Pita maꞌiyanao ꞌoidiya sihesilala, sigwae, “Tasimao ꞌalopuiya. Togidega nata ꞌapaihowa ꞌesa?”

Coinega Pita ꞌigwaeya, “Cimi paihowa galana ꞌoidiyega wanuwabui, ma mabwaiyami Toꞌabihetena Yesu saninega ꞌada ꞌabihe babitaisogomi, ma wete ꞌimi puiyao ꞌinuwasamudi, ta wete Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌiꞌebwaegomi.
Weyahina Yehoba ꞌina gwae hemisaina ꞌabehega ꞌomi weyahimi, ma natumiyao wete weyahidi, ma taudi bwaga ꞌana tomiyao weyahidi, taudi mabwaiyadi ꞌida Badaina Yehoba ꞌibwauwedi ꞌoina.”
Ma Pita ꞌina gwae ta ꞌina loguguya baibaiwana wete ꞌoidiyega ꞌihepwaila, ta ꞌigwaeya, “Ciyagwao, mehau galadi waꞌebesinedi ma ꞌabihetena waꞌebese.”
Coinega sabweloina ꞌoina Pita ꞌina gwae sihesagoheya, ta sibabitaiso, ta ꞌadi baibaiwa gidemusa ꞌetoi tausani,
ta sitagwala moisa tohepwailedi ꞌidi heꞌitao ꞌoidiya ma siheꞌiyaꞌiyagu moisa, ma siꞌai mahemahetena, ta wete siꞌahwaꞌahwanoi Yehoba ꞌoina.
Tohekalesiyao mumugadi
Ta mabwaiyadi Yehoba siheꞌasisiyeya, ma tohepwailao ꞌidi paihowao ꞌebehenainaida ma hedehedede baibaiwadi sipaihowediya.
Ma tohemisaowedi taudimo sihegogonedima, ta ꞌidi tobwatobwao sitagwalediya ma ꞌabehega tomota mabwaiyadi ꞌidi tobwatobwa.
Ta ꞌeguma ꞌidi ꞌebeloina ꞌasai simiyamiya sihegimwaneyedi ta ginaulaedi ꞌadi maisega siheguyaiyedi taudi geya ꞌidi tobwatobwaomo ꞌoidiya.
Coinega sabwelo ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiya maꞌidi ꞌatetagwala sitapwatapwalolo Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌoina, ma taudi ꞌidi hada maꞌidi yaliyaya siꞌai hegogona,

ma Yehoba sihehepwatuwe. Ta hesi tomota mabwaiyana tohemisaowedi siꞌahwa bwebweꞌanediya. Ma sabwelo ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiya Yehoba tupwana tomota wete ꞌiꞌabiꞌabihetedi, ta tohekalesiyao ꞌadi baibaiwa ꞌimadomadou.
